description: A viral disease that infects hosta plants. It does not kill the plant but causes permanent leaf damage and reduces ornamental quality. Once infected, the plant remains infected for life.
symptoms: Irregular light and dark green patterns on leaves
favorable_conditions: Mechanical damage to leaves or roots
Poor sanitation during pruning or plant division
Close contact between infected and healthy plants
management: Remove and destroy infected plants completely
Do not compost infected plant material
Disinfect tools and equipment after handling plants
Avoid planting new hostas in contaminated soil for at least 2 years
Use virus testing kits when infection is suspected
biological_control: No biological control currently available for HVX
chemical_control: No chemical treatment available for plant viruses such as HVX
prevention: Buy plants from reputable nurseries with sanitation protocols
Quarantine new hosta plants for several weeks
Wash hands and disinfect tools between plants
Use disinfectant solutions such as trisodium phosphate or laboratory detergents
